children: RAVE Restaurant Group reported fiscal 2026 net income of $2.9 million on revenue of $12.9 million, with adjusted EBITDA of $3.9 million for the year. For the fourth quarter ended June 28, 2026, the company recorded net income of $0.8 million and revenue of $3.4 million. Management highlighted five consecutive years of Pizza Inn buffet unit count growth and plans for accelerated Pizza Inn expansion in fiscal 2027.
Total revenue: $12.9 million for fiscal year ended June 28, 2026; Q4 revenue $3.4 million (quarterly increase of $0.3 million, +8.8% year-over-year).
Net income: $2.9 million for fiscal 2026; Q4 net income $0.8 million (Q4 decrease of 6.2% year-over-year).
Income before taxes: $3.9 million for fiscal 2026; Q4 income before taxes $1.1 million (Q4 decrease of 7.3% year-over-year).
Adjusted EBITDA: $3.9 million for fiscal 2026 (increase of $0.3 million from prior year); Q4 Adjusted EBITDA $1.2 million (increase of $0.1 million year-over-year).
Diluted earnings per share: $0.20 for fiscal 2026; Q4 diluted EPS $0.06 (unchanged year-over-year for the quarter).
Pizza Inn buffet unit count grew by a net one restaurant in fiscal 2026, marking the fifth consecutive year of buffet unit count growth.
RAVE total domestic comparable store retail sales increased 1.3% for the year; Pizza Inn domestic comparable store retail sales increased 2.4% for the year.
Pie Five domestic comparable store retail sales declined 9.9% for the year and decreased 17.3% in the fourth quarter versus the prior-year quarter.
Operational unit counts at quarter end: Pizza Inn domestic 91 units, Pizza Inn international 18 units, Pie Five domestic 13 units.
Company announced a 10-buffet development agreement with a multi-brand operator; first five restaurants under that agreement are anticipated to open in fiscal 2027.
